ai_summary: Dubai's 828-metre landmark and the world's tallest building, with observation decks on levels 124, 125 and 148.
place_tip: Book a sunset slot early; prime-time observation tickets sell first.
cost: At the Top tickets from AED 159 (Visit Dubai; dynamic pricing applies)
address: 1 Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Blvd, Downtown Dubai, Dubai
verification_notes: Visit Dubai confirms Burj Khalifa is 828m tall and lists At the Top observation decks on floors 124/125 plus level 148; ticket pricing starts at AED159. Admission is timed and operating slots vary by date, so flat daily hours are intentionally not asserted. [Sources: visitdubai.com; burjkhalifa.ae]

ai_summary: A 150-metre landmark in Zabeel Park framing panoramic views of old and modern Dubai.
place_tip: Go before sunset to see both daylight and city lights from the sky bridge.
cost: Adult AED 52.50; child age 3-11 AED 21 (Visit Dubai)
address: Zabeel Park, Za'abeel 1, Dubai
verification_notes: Visit Dubai lists 9:00 AM-9:00 PM daily and AED52.50 adult / AED21 child pricing. Public map data places the attraction at approximately 25.2355,55.3004. [Sources: visitdubai.com; dubaiframe.ae]

ai_summary: Dubai's torus-shaped future museum exploring science, technology, space, health and emerging ideas.
place_tip: Check live operating status before traveling; the current closure information conflicts across official channels.
cost: Temporarily closed; prior standard admission AED 169
address: Sheikh Zayed Road, Trade Centre 2, Dubai
verification_notes: CURRENT STATUS verified 2026-10-01: Museum of the Future's official FAQ says it has been temporarily closed since early September 2026 and is expected to reopen in Q1 2027. Older plan/visit pages still expose pre-closure hours/pricing and must not be treated as current. [Primary: museumofthefuture.ae official FAQ]

ai_summary: A large aquarium and underwater zoo inside Dubai Mall, known for its tunnel, sharks and rays.
place_tip: Pair it with Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Fountain in one Downtown visit.
advanced_booking: Advance ticket useful in peak periods
cost: Paid; ticket packages vary by experience and residency
address: Dubai Mall, Downtown Dubai, Dubai
verification_notes: Official ticket site lists Mon-Thu 11 AM-9 PM and Fri-Sun 10 AM-9 PM, last entry 8:15 PM; open 365 days a year. Ticket packages are dynamic, so no single general price is stored. [Source: thedubaiaquarium.com]

ai_summary: A landmark white-stone mosque known for its public cultural tours and Fatimid-inspired architecture.
place_tip: Join the cultural tour rather than visiting only for an exterior photo.
cost: Guided visit ticketed; confirm current SMCCU rate
address: Jumeirah Beach Road, Jumeirah 1, Dubai
verification_notes: Visit Dubai confirms the mosque welcomes visitors of all faiths and lists 75-minute guided tours six days a week at 10 AM through the Sheikh Mohammed Centre for Cultural Understanding. Exact weekly off-day/rate should be confirmed from SMCCU before publishing as a fixed schedule. [Sources: visitdubai.com; cultures.ae]

ai_summary: A heritage museum district on Dubai Creek covering the city's maritime history, perfume traditions and Emirati life.
place_tip: Allow extra time for the Perfume House and the Creek-focused galleries.
cost: Adult AED 35; child/student category AED 20 (Visit Dubai ticketing)
address: Al Shindagha, Dubai Creek, Dubai
verification_notes: Dubai Culture museum brochure lists daily 10 AM-8 PM. Visit Dubai ticketing lists AED35 adult and AED20 child ticket categories. Location approximately 25.2665,55.2890 from OpenStreetMap-derived public map data. [Sources: dubaiculture.gov.ae; visitdubai.com]

ai_summary: A museum at the historic Union House site explaining the formation of the United Arab Emirates and its modern history.
place_tip: Visit early, then continue along Jumeirah toward the mosque and coast.
cost: Adult AED 25; student age 5-24 AED 10; under 5 free
address: 1 Jumeirah Street, Al Mina, Dubai
verification_notes: Dubai Culture material lists daily 10 AM-8 PM, last entry 7 PM, guided tours at 12 PM and 5 PM; adult AED25, student AED10, under-5 free. Coordinates confirmed by Wikidata. [Source: Dubai Culture / Etihad Museum]

ai_summary: Dubai's historic precious-metals market in Deira, packed with gold, jewellery, gems and traditional trading shops.
place_tip: Compare several shops before buying and ask for the daily gold rate before negotiating workmanship charges.
cost: Free to visit; purchases extra
address: Deira, Dubai
verification_notes: Visit Dubai confirms Gold Souk is free to visit and says most shops operate about 10 AM-10 PM, with individual store hours varying. [Source: visitdubai.com]

ai_summary: A short ride on a traditional motorised abra linking Bur Dubai and Deira across Dubai Creek.
place_tip: Cross near sunset and combine with the souks and Al Fahidi/Al Shindagha heritage areas.
cost: AED 1 one-way on traditional crossing routes (Visit Dubai)
address: Dubai Creek, Bur Dubai / Deira, Dubai
verification_notes: Visit Dubai states traditional abras run every few minutes throughout the day across four Creek stations and the short one-way crossing costs AED1. Exact first/last departures vary by route; use RTA live schedule for production. [Sources: visitdubai.com; rta.ae]

ai_summary: A choreographed water, light and music show on Burj Lake at the base of Burj Khalifa.
place_tip: Arrive before the evening rush and watch from the Burj Lake promenade or Souk Al Bahar side.
cost: Free from public viewing areas; paid boardwalk/boat options available
address: Burj Lake, Downtown Dubai, Dubai
verification_notes: Visit Dubai confirms evening shows every 30 minutes from 6 PM to 11 PM, with limited afternoon shows as well; the fountain reopened on 1 Oct 2025 after refurbishment. [Source: visitdubai.com]

ai_summary: A seven-kilometre waterfront promenade around Dubai Marina lined with restaurants, towers and yacht views.
place_tip: Walk near sunset when temperatures are lower and the skyline begins to light up.
cost: Free
address: Dubai Marina, Dubai
verification_notes: Visit Dubai describes Marina Walk as a 7 km promenade that is free to visit and open at all hours; individual businesses along it have their own schedules. [Source: visitdubai.com]

ai_summary: An indoor ski slope and snow park inside Mall of the Emirates with skiing, snow play and penguin experiences.
place_tip: Reserve lessons or premium experiences ahead; basic snow-park access is easier to arrange.
cost: Paid; packages vary by slope/snow-park experience
address: Mall of the Emirates, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai
verification_notes: Visit Dubai ticketing lists Mon-Thu 10 AM-11 PM; Fri 10 AM-midnight; Sat-Sun 9 AM-midnight, with earlier last-entry cutoffs. Packages and prices vary. [Source: experiences.visitdubai.com]

ai_summary: A large wildlife park in Al Warqa with African, Asian, Arabian and safari zones and more than 3,000 animals.
place_tip: Visit when the new season is confirmed open; arrive at opening time for cooler weather and active animals.
cost: Standard ticket listed around AED 50 before VAT (Visit Dubai; verify new season)
address: Al Warqa 5, Dubai
verification_notes: As of 2026-10-01 the official site says the park is between seasons and will return for Season 8 in October 2026, but the exact reopening date was not captured. Official plan page lists 9 AM-6 PM; FAQ notes winter 9 AM-8 PM and summer 9 AM-6 PM. Visit Dubai lists standard entry around AED50 before VAT. Confirm new-season calendar before publishing live hours. [Sources: dubaisafari.ae; visitdubai.com]

ai_summary: A vast seasonal flower garden in Dubailand known for elaborate floral sculptures and installations.
place_tip: Only schedule this after the official site confirms the new season is open.
cost: Normal-season reference: adult AED 100; child age 3-12 AED 85 (Visit Dubai)
address: Al Barsha South 3, Dubailand, Dubai
verification_notes: CURRENT STATUS verified 2026-10-01: Dubai Miracle Garden official 2026/27 season information states Season 15 opens 8 Oct 2026 and lists daily hours 9 AM-9 PM. It is therefore closed through 7 Oct 2026. Ticket prices remain date/product sensitive. [Primary: dubaimiraclegarden.com]

ai_summary: A seasonal multicultural destination combining country pavilions, food, shopping, live entertainment and rides.
place_tip: Go after dark and allow several hours; the site is very large and highly seasonal.
cost: Paid; Season 31 price not captured in this pass
address: Wadi Al Safa 4, Dubai
verification_notes: CURRENT STATUS verified 2026-10-01: Global Village Season 31 runs from 14 Oct 2026 into May 2027. Official Season-31 terms list Sun-Wed 4 PM-midnight and Thu-Sat 4 PM-1 AM; Tuesdays are commonly reserved for ladies, families and couples except designated public holidays/events. Closed before 14 Oct. [Primary: globalvillage.ae]

ai_summary: A preserved old-Dubai quarter of wind-tower houses, lanes, courtyards, galleries and cultural spaces beside Dubai Creek.
place_tip: Walk it together with the Creek abra, Textile Souk and Al Shindagha Museum.
cost: Free to walk; individual museums/activities may charge
address: Bur Dubai, Dubai
verification_notes: Visit Dubai identifies Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood as a core heritage area beside Dubai Creek. Note that nearby Al Fahidi Fort/Dubai Museum is currently viewable only from outside because the museum is closed for renovations. [Sources: visitdubai.com]

ai_summary: The legacy city of Expo 2020, retaining Al Wasl Plaza, Terra, Alif and other interactive cultural and sustainability attractions.
place_tip: Use the Expo 2020 Metro Station and check which pavilions are operating before arrival.
cost: Public areas free; most ticketed attractions from AED 50 (Visit Dubai)
address: Expo Road, Dubai South, Dubai
verification_notes: Visit Dubai states admission to Expo City itself is free and most attractions start at AED50. Current ticketing copy says public areas are open 24/7 while pavilion operating hours shown are about 10 AM-6 PM with last entry 5:30 PM; confirm each pavilion before use. [Sources: visitdubai.com; expocitydubai.com]

ai_summary: A heritage-style Emirati restaurant and cafe in Al Fahidi, known for traditional breakfasts, rice dishes, grills and tea.
place_tip: Pair breakfast here with an early walk through Al Fahidi before the midday heat.
cost: Paid; menu pricing varies
address: Al Fahidi Street, Bur Dubai, Dubai
verification_notes: Official Arabian Tea House contact page confirms the Al Fahidi branch and lists working hours 7:00 AM-11:00 PM. Visit Dubai describes the restaurant as an Emirati dining experience in Al Fahidi. [Sources: arabianteahouse.com; visitdubai.com]

ai_summary: A contemporary Asian restaurant at Jumeirah Fishing Harbour with Japanese influences and a casual waterfront setting.
place_tip: It is walk-in only; arrive before peak dinner time if you want a shorter wait.
cost: Paid; menu item pricing published on official site
address: Shop 02, Jumeirah Fishing Harbour 1, Al Urouba Street, Jumeirah 1, Dubai
verification_notes: Official 3Fils site confirms the Dubai flagship at Jumeirah Fishing Harbour, open daily 12 PM-11:30 PM and walk-ins only. The site publishes a live AED menu and current restaurant recognition. [Source: 3fils.com]

ai_summary: A long-running family-run Iranian kebab restaurant in Bur Dubai known for grilled meats, saffron rice and affordable portions.
place_tip: Combine it with an Old Dubai evening; expect a casual, busy dining room.
cost: Budget; current numeric menu prices not captured in this pass
address: Ground Floor, Bahwan Plaza, Al Mussallah Road, Mankhool, Dubai
verification_notes: Visit Dubai confirms the restaurant, its Mankhool/Bur Dubai address and its reputation as an affordable Iranian kebab destination. Exact current operating hours were not captured from an authoritative source in this pass; keep hours flagged for confirmation. [Source: visitdubai.com]

ai_summary: A famous casual Pakistani restaurant in Satwa serving curries, grilled meats, naan, biryani and lassi.
place_tip: Sit outside in cooler weather for the classic Satwa street-side experience.
cost: Budget; Visit Dubai classifies it as $
address: Shop 245, Al Dhiyafa Road, Al Satwa, Dubai
verification_notes: Visit Dubai confirms the Satwa location, cuisine, signature dishes and budget positioning. Exact current operating hours were not captured from an authoritative first-party source during this pass, so they remain unverified. [Source: visitdubai.com]

ai_summary: Creekside heritage-style district mixing traditional Gulf architecture, waterfront walks, shops, restaurants and abra access.
place_tip: Walk the heritage section near sunset, then continue along Dubai Creek after dark.
cost: Public promenade free; shops and dining extra
address: Al Seef Street, Bur Dubai, Dubai
verification_notes: Visit Dubai identifies Al Seef as a creekside heritage and leisure district. Current Visit Dubai guidance lists retail roughly 10 AM-10 PM Mon-Thu and to 11 PM Fri-Sun; restaurants generally later. Public waterfront access is not treated as a single gated attraction. Coordinates from OpenStreetMap/Mapcarta. [Sources: visitdubai.com; alseef.ae; OpenStreetMap]

ai_summary: Popular beachfront promenade at Jumeirah Beach Residence with public sand, dining, shopping and family activities.
place_tip: Arrive before sunset for beach time and stay for the lit-up JBR promenade.
cost: Public beach access free; activities and dining extra
address: Jumeirah Beach Residence, Dubai
verification_notes: Verified as an open-access beachfront/promenade destination at JBR. There is no single attraction closing time; lifeguards, retail, restaurants and paid activities maintain their own schedules. [Sources: Visit Dubai; thebeach.ae]

ai_summary: Long public beach popular for swimming, kitesurfing, running, volleyball, food trucks and views toward Burj Al Arab.
place_tip: Go early for cooler weather and quieter sand; lifeguarded swimming areas are safest.
cost: Free public beach; rentals and activities extra
address: Jumeirah, Dubai
verification_notes: Visit Dubai describes Kite Beach as a public beach with 24/7 access and round-the-clock lifeguard coverage in designated areas; commercial facilities have their own schedules. Coordinates cross-checked with map sources. [Source: visitdubai.com]

ai_summary: Canal-side resort district with Souk Madinat Jumeirah, restaurants, traditional-style architecture and Burj Al Arab views.
place_tip: Walk the souk and canals at golden hour; waterfront terraces have excellent Burj Al Arab views.
advanced_booking: Restaurant booking recommended for prime dinner tables
cost: Free to enter public areas; dining, abra rides and activities extra
address: King Salman Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud St, Dubai
verification_notes: Visit Dubai lists Souk Madinat Jumeirah shops around 10 AM-11 PM and restaurants roughly 8 AM-2 AM, while hotel/resort facilities vary. [Sources: visitdubai.com; jumeirah.com]

ai_summary: Large Atlantis The Palm waterpark with major slides, river rides, family play zones and private-beach access.
place_tip: Arrive at opening; a full day is justified if you want the headline slides and family areas.
cost: Paid admission; dynamic ticket pricing
address: Atlantis The Palm, Crescent Road, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai
verification_notes: Official Aquaventure World currently lists the waterpark open 10 AM-6 PM daily. Ticket prices are dynamic/date-specific. [Primary: aquaventureworld.com]

ai_summary: Huge indoor theme park with Marvel, Cartoon Network, dinosaur and family entertainment zones.
place_tip: Because it is indoors, it works especially well during the hottest months.
cost: Paid admission; check live ticket price
address: City of Arabia, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Dubai
verification_notes: Official/current listings show Sun-Thu about 12 PM-10 PM and Fri-Sat about 12 PM-11 PM; special-event schedules can differ. Coordinates cross-checked against mapping sources. [Sources: imgworlds.com; visitdubai.com]

ai_summary: Immersive digital-art attraction at Wafi City with interactive light, sound and projection environments.
place_tip: Allow time to revisit the larger rooms; effects change as you move through them.
cost: Paid admission; check current online price
address: Wafi City, Oud Metha Road, Dubai
verification_notes: Official site currently lists Sun-Thu approximately 10 AM-10 PM and Fri-Sat approximately 10 AM-midnight, with last admission before closing. [Source: aya-universe.com]

ai_summary: Palm Tower observation deck overlooking Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina and the Arabian Gulf.
place_tip: Sunset slots are popular; book ahead if the view is a priority.
cost: Paid admission; ticket tiers vary
address: The Palm Tower, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai
verification_notes: Official site currently lists daily access around 10 AM-7 PM; timed products and premium decks may have separate schedules. Coordinates confirmed by OpenStreetMap/Commons. [Sources: theviewpalm.ae; OpenStreetMap]

ai_summary: Crocodile-focused zoological park with outdoor habitats, aquarium-style viewing and an educational museum.
place_tip: Late afternoon is cooler for the outdoor habitats.
cost: Adult AED 95; child AED 75 (official current listing)
address: Mushrif, Dubai
verification_notes: Official site currently lists 10 AM-8 PM daily and AED95 adult / AED75 child. A temporary Jun-Sep 2026 closure period has ended; the current site is again publishing normal hours. [Source: dubaicrocodilepark.com]

ai_summary: Protected urban wetland famous for winter flamingos and birdwatching hides with the Dubai skyline in the distance.
place_tip: Bring binoculars and go early; winter is best for migratory birds.
cost: Free
address: Ras Al Khor, Dubai
verification_notes: Dubai Municipality currently publishes seasonal visiting hours: approximately 7:30 AM-5:30 PM Oct-Mar and 6 AM-6 PM Apr-Sep. Free access; individual hides may be managed separately. Coordinates from OpenStreetMap. [Source: Dubai Municipality]

ai_summary: Large contemporary library and cultural centre in Al Jaddaf with multiple thematic collections, exhibitions and event spaces.
place_tip: Check event listings before you go; exhibitions and talks can add significantly to a visit.
cost: General library entry commonly free; paid events may apply
address: Al Jaddaf, Dubai
verification_notes: Identity and location are verified. Current map listings show Mon-Thu/Sat roughly 9 AM-9 PM, Fri 2 PM-9 PM and Sun closed, but an authoritative current hours page was not captured in this pass; confirm before publication. Visit Dubai describes general entry as free. [Sources: mbrl.ae; visitdubai.com; OpenStreetMap]

ai_summary: Abu Dhabi’s monumental white-marble mosque, renowned for its vast courtyard, domes, reflective pools and intricate Islamic craftsmanship.
place_tip: Arrive before sunset to experience the mosque in daylight, golden hour and evening illumination.
